notes.title: 📌 Name Update
notes.content:
[b]📌 Name Update[/b]

To prevent any potential copyright issues, we’ve renamed the game from “Together in Forgotten Realms” to Together in Forgotten Lands.

Same excitement, new name — the journey continues! 🎮💫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508501/87f86d48df078300dcfbb2f3734937f678f75478.png[/img]

📝 Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam and join us on this mysterious co-op adventure! 🧩💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508501/6dfc0176c4ca66b4514fa35943523ed2ac31f577.png[/img]
